text_block_list.text:
The day of Нарита Брайан's debut is finally
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I check the list, but there's a normal
number of
racers for a debut race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. How I'm feeling now doesn't
really
matter.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I won't know anything until I run. But this
just
might be the place that actually
fulfills me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...All right, it's time. My Twinkle Series
debut
starts here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
